parties: Manipal Health Enterprises Limited (acquirer) and Kindorama Healthcare Private Limited (seller)
headline: Manipal Health Enterprises acquires Kinder Women's Hospital and Fertility Centre, Bengaluru
sum: Manipal Health Enterprises has executed a Business Transfer Agreement to acquire the entire operations of Kinder Women's Hospital and Fertility Centre in Bengaluru's Doddanekundi Industrial Area. The acquisition expands Manipal's specialist women's and fertility care portfolio in the southern region.
implication: A strategic healthcare roll-up by a tier-1 operator highlights the consolidation dynamic in speciality women's health in India, and the BTA structure (assets + operations) typically avoids employment liabilities and simplifies regulatory approvals under the Clinical Establishments Act.
detail: Manipal Health Enterprises Limited, part of the Manipal Group's healthcare portfolio, has undertaken the acquisition of Kinder Women's Hospital and Fertility Centre via a Business Transfer Agreement dated 17 August 2026. The target operates as a specialist women's health and fertility services provider located in Doddanekundi Industrial Area, Bengaluru, Karnataka. The transaction was disclosed to the NSE in an official corporate announcement on 17 August 2026. The BTA structure indicates a transfer of the entire operating undertaking, including staff, equipment, patient records and goodwill, from Kindorama Healthcare Private Limited to Manipal Health Enterprises.
